trust_decision.summary: Whether an authenticated agent (JWT source_id claim) may write to a given source/agent record; the JWT is verified in the agent-server middleware but the agent handlers never compare its source_id to the source being written.

landing_point.why: The summary names the agent-API and the JWT source_id claim; the two agent handlers are the only agent-API operations, and UpdateSourceInventory is the one that writes source data.

fix_sites.entry_point: agent server router middleware chain (all agent routes)
auth.NewAgentAuthenticator constructor, used by the agent server

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/api_server/agentserver/server.go:77-82 with internal/config/config.go:43 — the auth-disabled config mode installs no agent context, so the new MustHaveAgent check would panic; the fix adds a none authenticator (fix.diff:13-21, fix.diff:34-43, fix.diff:138-191)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Auth-disabled mode is a dev/test configuration where there is no JWT, so a solver can say it has no tenant boundary and leave it alone, or just skip the check when no agent is in context.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With agent auth disabled (config default true, but switchable), the agent routes must keep working. A check that calls MustHaveAgent panics there (Recoverer turns it into a 500). The legitimate same-source update by a valid agent must also keep returning 200/201.

O6_input_shapes: source id in the URL path (UpdateSourceInventory request.Id)
source id in the JSON body (UpdateAgentStatus request.Body.SourceId)
auth-enabled (signed JWT in X-Agent-Token) vs auth-disabled (source id taken from the request body)

O7_producer.where: internal/auth/agent_authenticator.go:112-129 (puts AgentJWT into context); internal/auth/agent_authenticator.go:137-143 (maps the source_id claim)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UpdateAgentStatus checks only the body sourceId against the JWT; the agent id in the path is never bound to that source, so an existing agent row belonging to another source can be overwritten and reassigned (Updates writes SourceID).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The report talks about source_id; the agent id is a separate, random UUID, and the body source id now matches the token, so the request looks 'authorised'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same handler file as the landing point, sink in internal/service/agent.go and internal/store/agent.go:71-81 (2 packages away)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third agent-API route (e.g. agent heartbeat / delete agent / upload credentials-status) that takes a source id from path or body
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The agent API has only two generated operations (internal/api/server/agent/server.gen.go:365-368); adding a third strict-handler operation follows the existing generated pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: service-level check comparing the existing agent.SourceID with the form SourceID, which is missing in UpdateAgentStatus while UpdateSourceInventory has it (internal/service/agent.go:59-62)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It mirrors the existing check in the sibling service method, so its absence in one method reads as a plain oversight.

O9_family: broken access control / IDOR (CWE-639, authorization bypass through user-controlled key)

services: PostgreSQL (DB_TYPE default pgsql, internal/config/config.go:15; handler tests call store.InitDB, internal/handlers/v1alpha1/agent_test.go:29-33)
O10_build.project_tests: internal/handlers/v1alpha1/agent_test.go (handler tests with a DB), internal/auth/agent_authenticator_test.go (JWT middleware), internal/service/agent_test.go

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a MustHaveAgent source_id comparison only in UpdateSourceInventory (path id), missing the body-sourced id in UpdateAgentStatus and panicking in auth-disabled mode.

out_of_scope_notes: Image server (internal/api_server/imageserver/server.go:71-78) uses image tokens, not agent JWTs; not followed.

The published none authenticator reads sourceId from the body, but SourceStatusUpdate has no sourceId field (api/v1alpha1/agent/types.gen.go:21-24), so in auth-disabled mode the published UpdateSourceInventory check would compare against an empty string and return 403. Worth knowing for the hidden tests.
